description: Main loop implementation for MTP thread handling multiple communication protocols (STOMP, CoAP, MQTT, WebSockets, UDS) with socket-based wakeup mechanism and scheduled actions.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_MtpSendItem_Init
methods.description: Initializes an mtp_send_item_t structure with default values.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_Init
methods.description: Initializes socket pairs for wakeup queues for various protocols.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_ScheduleExit
methods.description: Signals the system to exit USP agent after all messages are sent.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Activates scheduled actions such as exit, reconnects, and protocol-specific wakeups.

methods.description: Main loop for STOMP protocol MTP thread, handling socket activity and exit conditions.

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_MqttMain

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_CoapMain

methods.name: MTP_EXEC_UdsMain
